scripts.prebuild: rm -rf ./dist && node -p "'export const VERSION = \'' + require('./package.json').version + '\';\nexport const NAME = \'' + require('./package.json').name + '\';'" > src/sdk-info.ts
scripts.build: node compile-assets.cjs && tsc -p ./tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias && cp -a src/vendor-js dist && cp src/sign/walletlink/relay/connection/HeartbeatWorker.js dist/sign/walletlink/relay/connection/
scripts.dev: yarn build && tsc --watch & nodemon --watch dist --delay 1 --exec tsc-alias
